named_subject: an ant (three round body segments, six legs, two antennae) standing on the ground
action: The ant stays in place on the ground, shuffling its legs and slowly tilting its body so the rear segment dips and the front rises, drifting slightly right.
identity_gap: The animated ant uses the same three loose round segments, short connecting dashes, straight stick legs and two antenna strokes as the doodle, mirrored to face right, with the head drawn somewhat smaller.
notes: The posture tilt and leg shuffling track the film ant's stance changes, but the film shows two ants meeting head to head and the second ant is missing, so the main event of the shot is not shown. Adding the second ant (or at least the antenna contact it makes with the first) would help most.
